fail_closed_reason: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: Trigger if dose bins provide no target-blind signal, if sparse strata dominate, or if OC fails to beat the preregistered comparator.

incumbent_comparator.baseline_name: drug-class frequency and dose-bin adverse-event baseline
incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: Predict held-out severity and dose-response class from drug class and preregistered dose bins without target-label access.
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: OC residual must beat the frequency dose-bin baseline under the declared pharmacovigilance uncertainty policy.

next_escalation: Implement a domain-specific scorer when this generic pack remains fail-closed.
no_fake_closure_policy: This pack is source-bound but cannot promote broad superiority unless actual target-hidden scoring materially beats the preregistered comparator.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: Acquire target-hidden source data, materialize OC and incumbent predictions, compute residuals, then rerun this pack and replay.

residual_requirement.superiority_rule: OC must beat the preregistered drug-class frequency comparator after sparse-strata controls.

residuals.material_margin_rule: OC must beat the preregistered drug-class frequency comparator after sparse-strata controls.

source.source_authority: U.S. Food and Drug Administration openFDA

target_variable.extraction_rule: Lock adverse-event reports and hide severity and dose-response class labels until OC and comparator scoring rows are preregistered.
target_variable.name: held_out_adverse_event_severity_and_dose_response_class
target_variable.unit: severity or dose-response class derived from locked adverse-event reports

uncertainty_requirement.metric: stratified bootstrap interval for severity and dose-response classification residuals
uncertainty_requirement.rule: Report stratified bootstrap uncertainty and fail closed when sparse dose strata make materiality unverifiable.

why_it_failed: Source identity and preregistered benchmark are present, but no target-hidden OC score with material superiority exists.
